about: Files moved here byte for byte from another code tree by tools/move-code-between-trees: each names its source path and commit, the identity of its source bytes and of its bytes here. Only import paths and the listed calls differ.

files.adapted: Only sourceRecord differs: it takes treeRoot, the top of the repository when the build runs inside an installed Workshop, and then asks the commit for each input at its path from that folder (an input outside it that is not in a node_modules folder is one the commit cannot hold); without it, it answers as before.
